_readme: S714 (rios, lane 1), the gap census's reader_page_assignment lever (run 45161770730): 3 programs of Cosumnes River College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and whose own section the 2026-27 catalog does not print. Free page read 45167465999 printed every page of the hand-filed catalog (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/cosumnes_river.json, sha256 pinned); the college's other 16 programs on the lever are pinned in its reconcile entry (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json, pdf_pages). These are filed as named gaps and are never sent to a paid read: no page holds their requirements. Their filed records stay as filed (the load skips a record that places none, d-load-skips-places-none-s697). No model call, no Supabase write. They are the college's to settle in COCI.

reasons.credit_not_in_catalog: A credit program the 2026-27 catalog prints under no heading of its own: no page of the hand-filed file names its title with its award, and the department's list of degrees and certificates does not list it.
